    The VP700P is crafted for quality, performance and incredible value. This entry-level solution gives you
    everything you need in a power supply. No twinkly lights or glittery paint jobs - a 120 mm fan for effective and
    quiet cooling, dual +12V rails for amazingly stable power and heavy-duty protection circuitry for peace of
    mind, no matter how demanding your system. And it comes with all the assurance of Antec's AQ2 Antec
    Quality 2 year limited warranty. All the features, none of the waste: for builders that are strictly business, the
    VP700P is strictly power.
